name: Fluoxetine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.action: Contraindicated; do not start an MAOI within 5 weeks of stopping fluoxetine.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other serotonergic drugs (SSRIs, SNRIs, triptans, tricyclics, opioids, lithium, buspirone, St John's wort)
key_interactions.action: Monitor; stop if serotonin syndrome occurs.

key_interactions.effect: Fluoxetine is a potent CYP2D6 inhibitor (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor tricyclic levels; lower substrate doses may be needed, also after recent fluoxetine use.

key_interactions.effect: Higher levels and anticonvulsant toxicity possible (label).
Longer diazepam half-life; more psychomotor impairment with alprazolam (label).

key_interactions.action: Warn the patient; monitor INR with warfarin.
